title: RiverCrossing UI automation scenario and observation, version 1
description: The v1 contract shared by the Rust harness and the Python parity driver. Observation.tree mirrors craft's flat ui.accessTree reply: nodes, focus and root. textSelection is a documented subset omission; a node that carries it still parses on the Rust side.

Scenario.title: Scenario
Scenario.description: One recorded UI scenario: a version, an id and the steps to run in order.

version.description: The scenario format version. Only 1 is defined.

size.description: The window size to run at, in points, when the scenario fixes one.

Step.title: Step
Step.description: One step: a command, a click, a typing, a key press, a snapshot or an expectation.

action.description: The frozen action id a `command` step sends.

params.description: The command parameters. Null asks the probe for its text field's contents.

selector.description: The node a `click`, `type` or `expect` step addresses.

key.description: The key name a `key` step presses, such as Enter.

modifiers.description: The modifier names held during a `key` press, such as ctrl.

name.description: The expected accessible name of an `expect` node, or the snapshot name.

value.description: The expected value of an `expect` node.

oneOf.description: Send a command through the automation channel.
Click the node the selector names.
Type text into the node the selector names.
Press a key, with optional modifiers.
Record a screenshot under this name.
Assert the accessible name and value of the node the selector names.

Selector.title: Selector
Selector.description: A stable handle on one UI node: a frozen action id first, an AccessKit role and label second.

role.description: The AccessKit role spelling, compared case-insensitively.

name.description: An alias for label, as the serde derive accepts it.

window.description: The window scope. A non-root window is unsupported at EPIC-10.

oneOf.description: An AccessKit role and label, optionally scoped to a window.

Observation.title: Observation
Observation.description: One settled view: the app, the viewport and the flat access tree, plus the screenshots written beside it.

app.description: The app that produced the observation.

version.description: The observation format version. Only 1 is defined.

tree.description: The flat access tree of the root window.

screenshots.description: The screenshot names written beside the observation.

WireTree.title: WireTree
WireTree.description: The flat access tree, as craft's ui.accessTree reply carries it.

nodes.description: The nodes, each naming its children by id.

focus.description: The focused node's id, when one is focused.

root.description: The root node's id, when the tree reports one.

Node.title: Node
Node.description: One flat node: its id, role, optional name and value, and its children's ids. Extra reply fields such as textSelection are ignored.

role.description: The AccessKit role spelling, as format!("{:?}", role) prints it.

name.description: The accessible name, when the node has one.

value.description: The accessible value, when the node has one.

children.description: The ids of the node's children, in their declared order.
